title: Act: Add createPhaserRenderContext
description: Create game/frontend/src/phaser/renderContext.ts exporting createPhaserRenderContext(scene, resolveKey) that returns a RenderContext whose createSprite builds a Phaser image, label text and RenderHandle.
acceptance_criteria: createSprite places an image using the spec position, scale, depth and resolved key
The handle implements highlight, label, visibility, hover, click and destroy

steps.action: Create the file importing Phaser, RenderContext, RenderHandle and RenderSpriteSpec from '@game/engine/renderContext'. Export createPhaserRenderContext(scene: Phaser.Scene, resolveKey: (id: string) => string): RenderContext whose createSprite(spec) does: image = scene.add.image(spec.x, spec.y, resolveKey(spec.key)).setOrigin(0,0).setScale(spec.scale).setDepth(spec.depth); if spec.bounds, image.setInteractive(new Phaser.Geom.Rectangle(b.x,b.y,b.width,b.height), Phaser.Geom.Rectangle.Contains); label = scene.add.text(spec.x, spec.y - 12, spec.label ?? '', {fontSize:'10px'}).setDepth(spec.depth+0.5).setVisible(false).
steps.code: export function createPhaserRenderContext(scene: Phaser.Scene, resolveKey: (id: string) => string): RenderContext { return { createSprite(spec) { /* as described */ } }; }
steps.expected: Function exported and returns an object with createSprite

steps.action: Return a RenderHandle: setVisible(v) calls image.setVisible(v) and, when v is false, label.setVisible(false); setHighlighted(on) calls image.setTint(0xfff2b0) when on else image.clearTint(); setLabelVisible(on) calls label.setVisible(on); onHover(cb) registers image.on('pointerover', () => cb(true)) and image.on('pointerout', () => cb(false)); onClick(cb) registers image.on('pointerdown', cb); destroy() calls image.destroy() and label.destroy().
steps.expected: All six RenderHandle methods exist and delegate to Phaser objects
